fields.Name: IT138 - Query Extraction Correctness
fields.Description: Saves fixture queries with extraction on (a normal save) over a fixture schema (mjit_extract: two tables and a view over a view, created and dropped by the bundle) and core MJ views, and asserts exactly what extraction wrote, on SQL Server and PostgreSQL. QE1 field rows of a query over tables: order, base and full type per platform, nullability (SQL Server reports it; PostgreSQL's describe does not), computed, and the schema.object source of a column no entity backs. QE2 a query over a view on a view keeps the inner types. QE3 a query over __mj.vwUsers binds each column to its MJ: Users field. QE4 Query Entities lists entities read in a CTE body, a join and an EXISTS subquery, never a CTE name spelled like an entity view. QE5 parameters are required only when a use sits outside every if, typed by their filters, with defaults and doc-comment and trailing --: descriptions on the right rows. QE6 the fields are the union of every branch render, with a note naming the else-branch column. QE7 an external-data-source query is Skipped and gets no fields. QE8 a query whose table is named by a template parameter keeps its declared fields. QE9 two output columns with one name are refused at save. QE10 ExtractionStatus, ExtractedSQLHash and UsesTemplate are recorded. QE11 a composition that leaves out a required parameter of its target is refused at save (MJQ_COMPOSITION_MISSING_ARGUMENT); one that passes it records its dependency by full path with the argument mapping. QE12 a JSDoc-style header (leading stars, an optional {type}, a '- ' separator, continuation lines, a bracket- or double-quoted field name) describes parameters and fields, and a header description beats a trailing --: one (MJQ_DOC_DUPLICATE, a located Warning); the {type} is not stored (Type follows the filter) and the summary is not written to the query's Description. QE13 an @param naming no parameter (MJQ_DOC_UNKNOWN_PARAMETER) and an unknown @tag (MJQ_DOC_UNKNOWN_TAG) are located Warnings in ExtractionMessage and write no row. QE14 an unpassed target parameter named like an outer parameter (MJQ_COMPOSITION_IMPLICIT_ARGUMENT) refuses the save of a new query, writing no query or dependency row, and is a Warning when a stored query (saved with extraction off) is refreshed. QE15 arithmetic and Context-token composition arguments are recorded in ParameterMapping as expressions, and the outer parameter they read is one required parameter of the composer; Context is never a parameter. Self-cleaning.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Extraction writes exactly the fields, entities and parameters the SQL and the database server establish, on both platforms.
